script.title: THE PAPER TRANSFER
script.title_quote: Fingers crossed for the coin fairy
script.scene_zh: 公車投幣區 · 索取轉乘單
script.story_hook: A coin hunt turns into a museum morning plan.
script.intro_zh: 翻找銅板之際，一趟看展的早晨計畫也成形了。
script.welcome_en: Welcome aboard! Today, bus fares and transfers.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎上車！今天來學車資與轉乘單。
script.outro: Coins counted, transfer stamped, museum ahead. Ride well!
script.outro_zh: 銅板數完、轉乘單蓋好，美術館就在前方。乘車愉快！
script.practice_intro_en: Now repeat the sixty lines with feeling.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在帶著感情，把六十句跟讀一遍。
script.char_a_description: a plump elderly woman with short silver curly hair, thick tortoiseshell glasses, a long burgundy wool coat over a floral blouse, a knitted scarf, pearl earrings, and a canvas tote bag
script.char_b_description: a tall man in his forties with a shaved head and a warm smile, a navy transit uniform jacket with a name badge, dark gray slacks, reflective gloves tucked in a pocket, and a broad build
script.char_b_role: bus driver at the fare box

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning. Is this the 12 bus?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ɪz ðɪs ðə twɛlv bʌs/
dialogue.zh: 早安，這班是12路公車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning! Yes, it runs all the way downtown.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔɹnɪŋ jɛs ɪt ɹʌnz ɔl ðə weɪ ˈdaʊnˌtaʊn/
dialogue.zh: 早安！是的，一路開進市中心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Um, how much is the fare?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpəɹfɪkt ʌm haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə fɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。呃，車資是多少呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two fifty, exact change, no bills.
dialogue.zh: 兩塊五，只收剛好的銅板，不找紙鈔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh my. I only have a five.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ maɪ aɪ ˈoʊli hæv ə faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 哎呀，我手上只有五塊的紙鈔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, do you have a card?
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那你有刷卡的卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is older than my coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ɪz ˈoʊldɚ ðæn maɪ koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 我的手機呀，比我這件外套還有年头。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Fair enough. Let me think a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɛɹ ɪˈnʌf lɛt mi θɪŋk ə ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，說得有理，容我想一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No rush at all, young man.
dialogue.zh: 不急不急，孩子你慢慢想。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a coin machine at the library stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz ə kɔɪn məˈʃin ʔæt ðə ˈlaɪˌbɛɹi stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 圖書館那站有個兌幣機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's three blocks behind me today.
dialogue.zh: 那可在我身後三個街口了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True. Any change hiding in the purse?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹu ˈɛni tʃeɪndʒ ˈhaɪdɪŋ ɪn ðə pɜɹs/
dialogue.zh: 說得也是，皮包裡也許藏著零錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait… maybe in my coat pocket.
dialogue.zh: 等等…說不定在我外套口袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fingers crossed for the coin fairy.
dialogue.zh: 許個願，盼銅板精靈降臨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! Five quarters in here!
dialogue.zh: 喔！這裡有五個二十五分銅板！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? That's half the ride, plus more.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðæts hæf ðə raɪd plʌs mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 看吧？一半車資有了，還多出一截。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need ten quarters, right?
dialogue.zh: 總共要十個銅板，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You do. There's a jar right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju du ðɛɹz ə dʒɑɹ raɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，投幣罐就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There we go. Did it count?
dialogue.zh: 投好啦，機器數對了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All two fifty. You're golden.
dialogue.zh: 整整兩塊五，你過關啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful. Now, I need a transfer.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。接著，我要一張轉乘單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the crosstown? Where to?
dialogue.zh: 要轉橫穿市區那班嗎？要去哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The art museum on Fifth Street.
dialogue.zh: 第五街的美術館。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that's the 30, from City Hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts ðə θɜɹti fɹʌm ˈsɪti hɔl/
dialogue.zh: 喔，那得從市政廳搭30路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: City Hall. Can I get off there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪti hɔl kæn aɪ ɡɛt ɔf ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 市政廳。我可以在那兒下車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, and grab a paper transfer.
dialogue.zh: 當然，下車前拿一張紙本轉乘單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper? Doesn't the card do it?
dialogue.zh: 紙的？刷卡不能搞定嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper's easiest—no app needed.
dialogue.zh: 紙本最省事，完全不用手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds perfect. Do I sign it?
dialogue.zh: 聽起來剛好。我要簽名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll stamp it; just show the driver.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl stæmp ɪt dʒʌst ʃoʊ ðə ˈdɹaɪvəɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我蓋章就好，上別車時給司機看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. How long is it good for?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ɪt ɡʊd fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好，這張轉乘單有效多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety minutes from this stamp.
dialogue.zh: 從蓋章這刻起九十分鐘內有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety! I'll browse with zero rush.
dialogue.zh: 九十分！那我可以從容地逛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the spirit. Mind the steps.
dialogue.zh: 就是要這種心情，小心階梯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. Which seat's best for getting off?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju wɪtʃ sits bɛst fɔɹ ˈɡɛtɪŋ ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。坐在哪裡下車最方便？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Front two rows, near the doors.
dialogue.zh: 前面兩排，靠近車門就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. One more silly question.
dialogue.zh: 好。還有一個傻傻的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing's silly, ask away.
dialogue.zh: 才不傻，您請問無妨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this bus get very crowded?
dialogue.zh: 這班公車會很擁擠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After seven, it fills up fast.
dialogue.zh: 七點過後，車厢很快就坐滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm early, so I'll grab two seats.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈɜɹli soʊ aɪl ɡɹæb tu sits/
dialogue.zh: 我搭得早，那就佔兩個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Legroom side or window side?
dialogue.zh: 聰明。要伸腿寬敞那側，還是靠窗那側？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Window, please. I like watching streets.
dialogue.zh: 靠窗，請。我愛看街景慢慢退後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best seat in the house, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，那是全車最好的座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, how many stops is City Hall?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ haʊ ˈmɛni stɑpz ɪz ˈsɪti hɔl/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，市政廳有幾站呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four stops. I'll call it out loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ stɑpz aɪl kɔl ɪt aʊt laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 四站，到站我會大聲報站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You would do that for me?
dialogue.zh: 您願意特地為我報站嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. I announce every stop.
dialogue.zh: 當然囉，每一站我都會報。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're very kind. How is your morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈvɛɹi kaɪnd haʊ ɪz jʊɹ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你真好，今天早班還順利嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet traffic, warm bus. I'm winning.
dialogue.zh: 路上清靜，車厢暖和，我賺到啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! That's a good way to say it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæts ə ɡʊd weɪ tə seɪ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈！這說法真讓人開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I practice on nice passengers.
dialogue.zh: 我專挑和氣的乘客練嘴皮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I'm off to see some paintings.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪm ɔf tə si səm ˈpeɪntɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 總之，我這是要去看幾幅畫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's free the first Sunday, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts fɹi ðə fəɹst ˈsʌnˌdeɪ baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對了，每月第一個週日免費入場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today is the first Sunday!
dialogue.zh: 今天就是第一個週日呀！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Good luck travels on this bus.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ɡʊd lʊk ˈtɹævəlz ɑn ðɪs bʌs/
dialogue.zh: 看吧？好運就在這班車上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You just made my whole week.
dialogue.zh: 你讓我整個星期都亮起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four stops—get ready, ma'am.
dialogue.zh: 四站到了，請您準備起身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm up. Thank you, driver friend.
dialogue.zh: 我起身啦，謝謝你，司機朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy the museum. Bye now!
dialogue.zh: 好好看展，再見！

script.youtube_title_en: "Fingers Crossed for the Coin Fairy" — Asking About a Bus Transfer
script.youtube_description:
上公車沒有零錢怎麼辦？這段60句美式英文聽力，帶你從找銅板一路聊到看展覽🚌

一位老婆婆帶著五塊紙鈔上車，司機沒有找零，只有投幣罐與一個提議。兩人從零錢翻到轉乘單，從九十分鐘有效期聊到免費週日。整段對話單一場景、自然延伸，句句都是搭車日常聽得懂、說得出的關鍵句。

你會聽到：
- 問車資：Um, how much is the fare?
- 問轉乘：Okay. How long is it good for?
- 問座位：Which seat's best for getting off?
- 暖心收尾：I'll call it out loud.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習🎧，每句不超過10個單字，附連讀IPA標音，適合A2初級學習者反覆磨耳朵。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道並按小鈴鐺，每週一集新的沉浸式英文動畫！
script.youtube_description_en:
No coins for the bus? This 60-line American English listening scene turns a coin hunt into a friendly plan for the museum 🚌

A rider boards with only a five-dollar bill. The driver has no change, just a fare box and a few ideas, and the conversation keeps branching: paper transfers, ninety minutes, window seats, and free Sundays. One continuous scene, every line useful at the next bus stop you reach.

You will hear:
- Asking the fare: Um, how much is the fare?
- Transfer details: Okay. How long is it good for?
- Seat choice: Which seat's best for getting off?
- Kind driver: I'll call it out loud.

The second half is line-by-line listening plus shadowing practice 🎧, with short sentences under 10 words and connected-speech IPA. Built for A2 learners.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe and hit the bell for a new immersive English animation every week!

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
上車才發現只帶了大紙鈔，怎麼辦？
紙本轉乘單要怎麼拿、能用多久？

這一集帶大家走進公車前門的投幣區，聽一位司機和看展乘客把零錢危機，聊成一趟完整的早班計畫。

你會聽到：
🪙 問車資：Two fifty, exact change, no bills. 一句掌握投規矩。
🎫 要轉乘單：Sure, and grab a paper transfer. 紙本轉乘怎麼拿。
⏳ 確認效期：Ninety minutes from this stamp. 有效時間問清楚。
📢 請人報站：Four stops. I'll call it out loud. 下車前最暖的一句話。

後半段為逐句聽力＋跟讀練習🎧，句子簡短、唸法連讀，反覆聽幾輪，下次上車就張得開嘴。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用，把搭車關鍵句聽成本能。

祝你上車永遠有銅板，下車永遠報得準。
